description: Comment thread component with inline rich text editing via TmRichEditorSimple. Supports adding, editing, and deleting comments with author avatars, relative timestamps, and edit indicators. Communicates changes via EventCallbacks. Exposes a draft-guard surface: OnDraftChanged reports every TmCommentDraftState transition (editor open/closed, which comment is edited, whether unsaved content exists) with value-equality dedup, HasUnsavedDraft polls the same flag at any time, and DiscardDraftAsync closes the editor after the consumer's own confirmation.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the TmCommentDraftState value changes — editor opened/closed, the edited comment changed, or HasUnsavedContent flipped (e.g. first character typed, edit reverted to the original). Value-equality deduped, so it does NOT fire on every keystroke. Consumers use TmCommentDraftState to build a dirty-guard before discarding an in-progress comment; the record carries flags only, never the draft text.

examples.title: Dirty-guard from OnDraftChanged before a page refresh
examples.description: The record carries flags only — never the draft text. Dedup guarantees the callback does not fire on every keystroke.
examples.code:
<TmActivityComments Comments="@comments"
                     OnCommentAdded="HandleAdd"
                     OnCommentDeleted="HandleDelete"
                     OnCommentEdited="HandleEdit"
                     OnDraftChanged="HandleDraftChanged" />

@code {
    private TmCommentDraftState _draft = new(false, null, false);

    private void HandleDraftChanged(TmCommentDraftState state) => _draft = state;

    private async Task ReloadAsync()
    {
        // Dirty-guard: ask before a refresh would throw the in-progress comment away.
        // For an edit, HasUnsavedContent means the body differs from the original;
        // for a new comment, that the content is not empty.
        if (_draft.HasUnsavedContent && !await ConfirmDiscardDraftAsync())
        {
            return;
        }

        comments = await api.GetCommentsAsync();
    }
}

examples.title: Discarding an unsaved comment draft via @ref
examples.code:
<TmActivityComments @ref="_comments"
                     Comments="@comments"
                     OnCommentAdded="HandleAdd"
                     OnCommentDeleted="HandleDelete"
                     OnCommentEdited="HandleEdit" />

@code {
    private TmActivityComments? _comments;

    private async Task DiscardUnsavedDraftAsync()
    {
        // HasUnsavedDraft mirrors the OnDraftChanged HasUnsavedContent flag; read it on the
        // component's dispatcher (an event handler or InvokeAsync) from background threads.
        if (_comments is not null && _comments.HasUnsavedDraft && await Confirm())
        {
            await _comments.DiscardDraftAsync();
        }
    }
}
